subject.title: fix: stabilize room-event prompt cache mode

question: Should ambient room_event runs use the safe non-owner owner-only Gateway tool inventory for every sender while keeping actual visible delivery message-tool-only and prompt-facing delivery session-stable?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but changing owner-sent ambient room-event tool inventory is a product and security-boundary policy choice rather than a purely mechanical cache fix.

options.title: Accept Prompt-Stable Room Events
options.body: Merge after confirming ambient room events should use the safe non-owner owner-only tool inventory for every sender.

options.title: Preserve Owner Room-Event Tools
options.body: Require a revision that keeps owner-only tools for owner-sent room events and accepts or separately handles the remaining cache split.

options.title: Pause For Explicit Contract
options.body: Hold the PR until room-event visible-reply and tool-inventory behavior is documented or made configurable.

recommendation.title: Accept Prompt-Stable Room Events
recommendation.body: Merge after confirming ambient room events should use the safe non-owner owner-only tool inventory for every sender.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice is closest to the visible-reply and ambient-room policy introduced in the prior merged policy PR.
